comments.author: feross
comments.why: Shows large JS frameworks blow the performance budget before app code
comments.text: Alex Russell first diagnosed this problem at Chrome Dev Summit in 2016 in a really amazing talk: [VIDEO] He makes the point that lots of JS frameworks are so large that you're already doomed before you write the first line of real "app code". The framework itself has already blown your performance budget.

comments.author: scribu
comments.why: Makes a stronger case for the need for progressive web apps
comments.text: Those words are meant for people who have the question "why should I go through all this trouble to implement this pattern?" That said, it is very vague. I think this presentation from Alex Russell does a much better job of demonstrating the need for progressive web apps: [VIDEO]
